description:
**HackSpire'26 – The Flagship Hackathon of FIEM ACM Student Chapter**

HackSpire is the flagship annual hackathon organized by the **FIEM ACM Student Chapter**, recognized as the **Most Active ACM Student Chapter in East India**. Following the tremendous success of our previous editions—including **4100+ registrations, 270 in-person participants, and 50+ innovative project submissions**—we are excited to announce **HackSpire'26**, set to be bigger, bolder, and more impactful than ever before.

HackSpire brings together some of the brightest student innovators, developers, and creators from across the country for an intense **26-hour hackathon experience** filled with innovation, collaboration, and learning. Participants will work in teams to build solutions for real-world challenges while exploring cutting-edge technologies across multiple domains.

### 📍 Event Details

**Event:** HackSpire'26
**Venue:** Future Institute of Engineering and Management, Kolkata
**Duration:** 26 Hours of Innovation

### Why join HackSpire'26?

 **Build innovative projects** across software and hardware tracks
 **Solve real-world problems** through curated problem statements
 **Learn from mentors and industry experts** through workshops and sessions
 **Network with developers, founders, and tech communities**
 **Win exciting prizes, swags, and recognition**

At HackSpire, we believe hackathons are not just about competition—they are about **collaboration, creativity, and community building**. Whether you are a beginner exploring your first hackathon or an experienced hacker ready to push boundaries, **HackSpire'26** provides the perfect platform to **learn, build, and showcase your ideas** at one of Kolkata’s most exciting student-led hackathons.

hackathon_faqs.answer: HackSpire is the flagship 26-hour hackathon of the FIEM ACM Student Chapter — and one of the biggest hackathons in Kolkata — where innovators, developers, and designers come together to create impactful solutions in a high-energy environment.
hackathon_faqs.question: What is HackSpire?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Anyone with a passion for innovation! Whether you’re a student, fresher, or experienced professional, you’re welcome. Teams can have members from different colleges or backgrounds.
hackathon_faqs.question: Who can participate?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Nope! Participation in HackSpire is completely free.
hackathon_faqs.question: Do I need to pay to participate?

hackathon_faqs.answer: HackSpire'26 will be held from October 02 to October 03, 2026 at Future Institute of Engineering and Management, Kolkata.
hackathon_faqs.question: When and where is HackSpire 2026 happening?

prizes.desc: A total cash prize pool of $1,000 USD distributed among the top-performing teams and special award categories, including Winner, First Runner-Up, Second Runner-Up, Best UI/UX, Best Hardware, Best Beginner, Best All-Men Team, and other overall awards.
prizes.name: HackSpire'26 Grand Prize

prizes.desc: 3 months of the ElevenLabs Scale Plan for each member of the winning team. $897 value per member, $3,588 total for a 4-member team.
prizes.name: Best Project Built with ElevenLabs

sponsors.about: We’re excited to have ElevenLabs as an In-Kind Sponsor of HackSpire’26. ElevenLabs is supporting our hackers with access to its powerful AI voice technology, enabling participants to experiment, innovate, and build real-world applications using its platform.
sponsors.name: ElevenLabs

sponsors.about:
**.xyz — In-Kind Sponsor**

All **in-person participants of HackSpire ’26** will get access to a **free .xyz domain for the first year**, helping them build and launch their projects with a professional web presence.
sponsors.name: .xyz

sponsors.about: **In-Kind Technology Partner** — n8n is supporting HackSpire'26 with 300 n8n Cloud Pro licenses, enabling participants to access the full platform during the hackathon and build AI-powered workflows, automations, integrations, and innovative developer solutions.
sponsors.name: n8n
